# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
For the most severe defects identified in the records, perform the following steps:
    2.1. Review the structural details and specifications of the bridge.
    2.2. Inspect the bridge in person and take note of the location and severity of the defects.
    2.3. Use specialized equipment (e.g., a tape measure, a level, a camera) to accurately measure the extent of the defects.
    2.4. Make notes of repairs or replacements that have been made to the bridge in the past.
    2.5. Assess the overall condition of the bridge.
3. Formulate and record the most severe defect.
4. Use the maintenance records and the results of your inspection and measurements to document the defects accurately and comprehensively.
